hypothesis: Training the FM with pairwise BPR loss (sampling within-user positive/negative pairs) instead of pointwise BCE will improve GAUC and nDCG@5, because the loss directly optimizes relative ordering within each user's candidate set
mechanism: GAUC is per-user AUC — it measures whether the model ranks positives above negatives within each user's list. Pointwise BCE trains to minimize absolute prediction error, which does not directly optimize this ordering. BPR creates (user, pos, neg) triplets and maximizes sigma(score_pos - score_neg), directly maximizing per-user AUC. With only ~5 items per user in evaluation, getting the within-user ordering right is critical.
